# axm packs version

Bump a managed pack manifest version

## When to use

Bump a managed pack manifest version

## Usage

```bash
axm packs version [flags] <handle> <bump> [<version>]
```

## Arguments

| Name      | Type   | Required | Description                                     |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `handle`  | string | Yes      | Fully-qualified pack handle (@owner/packs/name) |
| `bump`    | string | Yes      | Version bump rule or set                        |
| `version` | string | No       | Exact semver version for set                    |

## Flags

| Name        | Type    | Required | Description                    |
| ----------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------ |
| `--preview` | boolean | No       | Print the bump without writing |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Bump the patch version**

```bash
axm packs version @acme/packs/frontend-tools patch
```

**Set an exact version**

```bash
axm packs version @acme/packs/frontend-tools set 1.2.3
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
